versions.changelog: v2.3 quality enhancement - security audit + marketing packaging + slug-content validation

Initial release of tts-whatsapp-tool-free:

- Enables sending high-quality voice messages to WhatsApp using Piper TTS, supporting 40+ languages.
- Converts text to WhatsApp-compatible OGG/Opus audio format.
- Allows single-message sending to individual contacts (group and bulk sending available in pro version).
- Includes configurable parameters for language, voice, quality level, and speech speed.
- Supports automatic cleanup of temporary files after sending.
- No API key required for TTS; all processing is done locally.
